shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && rg -n \"conversation list|conversation_list|list_conversations\" specs .lore --glob '*.md' --glob '*.yml' || true && rg --files | rg '(acceptance\\.test|test\\.(ts|tsx|js)"'$|spec'"\\.md"'$|test-commands|package.json$)'"' | head -200"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '1,260p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/transport/createServer.test.ts
sed -n '1,300p' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts
sed -n '1,240p' src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/createServer.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/types/session.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/types/messages.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/config.ts
git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/types/sessionStore.ts
sed -n '1,260p' src/infrastructure/stores/inMemorySessionStore.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/shared/logger.ts
rg -n \"specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol|spec:\" src scripts | head -100
rg -n \"validated by:\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | tail -20
rg -n \"reanchor\" scripts package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|@spec|spec anchor|spec:\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80
sed -n '300,350p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '610,650p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,100p' src/infrastructure/stores/inMemoryConversationList.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff -- src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | sed -n '1,320p'
git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git commit -m "test websocket conversation list acceptance" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
